core_obligations: The author constructs a transitive game through an outer PCP and subspace-based inner test, proves its covering and completeness properties, and decodes a hypothetical list coloring in the conditional soundness argument. The original Grassmann Hypothesis conj:main2 remains an explicit assumption; the related independent-set and vertex-cover consequences are context, not additional counted tasks.
